collection.description: A visitor speaks unfamiliar words over a meal, and a villager wonders what they mean.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A visitor speaks unfamiliar words over a meal. A local villager wonders whether the gesture is sacred, ordinary, or a warning.

choices.label: Offer a local blessing in return

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The visitor explains a family custom, and both exchange stories.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The visitor smiles but does not adopt the custom; mutual respect remains.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: No explanation comes, yet the meal is peaceful.
